name: Saigo no Yurikago
source:
In the future, all life is controlled by a computer. All behavior, even thoughts. Everything is determined by the program that calculates the probability. 

The human race has decided to send someone on a one-way trip to search for the ends of the undiscovered universe. 

It was the boy Igarashi who just graduated from high school this year that was to be given a ticket for the journey of the dead.
translation:
未来，所有生命都由计算机控制。所有行为，甚至思想，都不例外。一切都由计算概率的程序决定。

人类决定派遣一人踏上单程旅途，寻找尚未被发现的宇宙尽头。

今年刚从高中毕业的五十岚少年，获得了那张通往亡者之旅的船票。
